notes: Paper reports limits on scalar dark matter coupling to photons (dilaton-like) via fine-structure constant oscillations in dysprosium spectroscopy. Data extracted from Figure 4 and text. The coupling d_e parameterizes the interaction L ⊃ (-1 + d_e κ φ / 4e²) F_μν F^μν. Most sensitive mass window is m_φ ~ 10^-22 eV where d_e ≈ 4.2×10^-8. Limits exceed equivalence-principle tests by up to 4 orders of magnitude for m_φ < 3×10^-18 eV. DM density assumed is ρ_DM ≈ 0.3 GeV/cm³ (local galactic halo). Excess power detected in control channel at ω ≈ 1.4×10^-3 rad/s attributed to systematic effect; limits derived after subtracting this. Data points read from Figure 4 (ST data set, 19 Oct 2012) spanning mass range 10^-24 to 10^-15 eV. | selector: text (sole candidate)
